subject: NimbusEdge private deploy preflight: VPC lift-and-shift checklist & timeline
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@nimbusedge.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Malhotra <p.malhotra@nimbusedge.com>, it-ops <it-ops@nimbusedge.com>
Date: 2026-10-11 08:22 -0700
Subject: Re: NimbusEdge private deploy preflight: VPC lift-and-shift checklist & timeline

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the notes in the call. We sketched a few changes since the demo: we plan to lift-and-shift traffic to a private endpoint in our VPC and keep the public-facing ingress for the first 4 weeks for failover. Can the on-prem package (edge appliance) be pre-staged with the LTS runtime you mentioned? If so we'll need the manifest and SHA for our security team.

Specific asks from IT Ops:
- Egress IP ranges used by Redwood runtime (CIDR list)
- BGP vs static routing preference for peered subnets
- TLS cert requirements for private endpoints (SANs, CA)
- Expected open ports to allow from our firewall (UDP for health checks?)

I attached the network diagram we use internally. Can your team review and call out anything we missed?

Alex
Head of Infrastructure — NimbusEdge Systems

Attachment: nimbusedge_network_diagram_v2.pdf (diagram, 1.2MB)

From: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@nimbusedge.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11 11:03 -0700
Subject: Re: NimbusEdge private deploy preflight: VPC lift-and-shift checklist & timeline

Alex — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below. I'm looping Ben and Marissa for SOW/ops handoff and Camila for private package delivery.

Short answers:
- Egress: we'll provide a stable set of /24s; for planning use 34.120.58.0/24 and 34.120.59.0/24 as placeholders. Final list after allocation.
- Routing: we support both static and BGP; for large AWS VPCs we recommend BGP for automatic route convergence.
- TLS: we can accept customer-provided SAN certs or use mutual TLS. Required SANs: privateapi.nimbusedge.internal and edge-proxy.nimbusedge.internal (we'll confirm exact CNs after you share the endpoint hostnames).
- Ports: 443 (HTTPS) for control plane and data plane; 2200 TCP for appliance SSH; 12345 TCP for health/metrics (configurable). No mandatory UDP unless you enable our optional probe.

Deliverables we'll share by EOD tomorrow:
1) RDW_Mutual_Action_Plan_7521.xlsx (timeline, owners, gating criteria)
2) onprem_package_manifest.zip (runtime binary checksums, install preflight)
3) Full egress CIDR list and ASN recommendations if you opt for BGP

Request: please confirm your maintenance window for the initial cutover (preferred: weekend midnight window, Oct 24-25), and whether you need a canary route first.

I'll set up a dedicated implementation Slack channel after we confirm the cutover window.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Senior Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference

Attachment: RDW_Mutual_Action_Plan_7521.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Priya Malhotra <p.malhotra@nimbusedge.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@nimbusedge.com>, it-ops <it-ops@nimbusedge.com>
Date: 2026-10-12 09:14 -0700
Subject: Re: NimbusEdge private deploy preflight: VPC lift-and-shift checklist & timeline

On Mon, Oct 11, 2026 at 11:03 AM Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Alex — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below. I'm looping Ben and Marissa for SOW/ops handoff and Camila for private package delivery.

Thanks Soojin — a couple clarifications from our side:
- Our security team requires the manifest SHA256 for every binary before we open any firewall ports. Please include checksums in the onprem_package_manifest.zip.
- For BGP we use ASNs in the 65000 range internally; if Redwood supports private ASN peering we can provide exact numbers.
- We prefer a small canary (10% traffic) for 48 hours before full cutover. Can you confirm Redwood supports traffic-splitting at the route level?

Also pinging question for Ben: will there be any changes to the committed capacity or billing during the canary window?

Priya
IT Operations — NimbusEdge

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Malhotra <p.malhotra@nimbusedge.com>, soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12 11:26 -0700
Subject: Re: NimbusEdge private deploy preflight: VPC lift-and-shift checklist & timeline

Priya — short answer on billing: during the canary we can mirror your traffic to a reserved pool with a temporary burst allowance; we'll keep chargebacks aligned to usage with a note in the MPA. No mandatory contract changes for <30 day canaries. Marissa, can you confirm the language?

Ben Carter
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Malhotra <p.malhotra@nimbusedge.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-14 16:04 -0700
Subject: Re: NimbusEdge private deploy preflight: VPC lift-and-shift checklist & timeline

Priya / Alex / team — added a few contract-ops notes inline in the MPA and uploaded a signed SOW redline to the Drive folder. High level:
- Canary allowances: Redwood will provide a 14-day burst period at the current committed rate. After the 14 days we will evaluate sustained usage and propose a commit if needed.
- Security: we'll include a compliance addendum that lists required evidence (manifest checksums, SOC2 report, network flow logs access).
- Cutover window: confirmed Oct 24-25 as proposed; please confirm specific blackout periods for your apps so we can coordinate DB locks and rolling restarts.

Next step: let's do a 30-minute technical preflight on Oct 18 at 10:00 PT to walk through diagram, firewall rules, and the on-prem manifest. I will send a calendar invite and include the implementation runbook link.

Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead — Redwood Inference

Attachment: onprem_package_manifest.zip (contains checksums)
